newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-CC Amatil begins second Ukraine plant.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-CC Amatil begins second Ukraine plant.

text.p: Coca-Cola Amatil Ltd said on Thursday it had begun construction of a new A$149 million production facility near Kiev, its second plant in Ukraine.
The facility, at Brovary, would eventually become one of the largest integrated Coca-Cola complexes in Europe, it said.
"Added to the company's first plant, opened in L'viv in western Ukraine in January this year, total investment is expected by mid-1997 to exceed A$211 million," the company said.

Coca-Cola Amatil, 36.12 percent owned by Coca-Cola Co , said at the opening of the L'viv plant that it intended to build a second facility near Kiev. Shares in Coca-Cola Amatil closed on Thursday at A$14.65, down 30 cents, a continuation of the sell-down which followed a profit warning late last Friday.
Coca-Cola Amatil shares have fallen A$2.89, or 16.5 percent, from Friday's close of A$17.54.
